description: four separate big layered rock formations for a top-down 3/4 view action RPG, seen from above at an angle: chunky stacked grey-beige boulders with flat tops and cracked faces, soft shading lit from the upper left, small grass tufts at the base; arranged in a 2 by 2 grid with empty space between them: a big wide rock pile, a tall stacked rock, a long low rock ridge, a cluster of medium boulders; detailed modern pixel art, on a plain flat pure white background
